title: Go-live deployment of approved Draft Version 4

requirements.text: Deploy the currently approved “Draft Version 4” of the Krishna Traders website to the production Internet Computer canister(s) and perform a go-live verification pass to confirm the public site is accessible and key pages load correctly.

quotes: Yes header is good you can go live with this

acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment completes successfully without build errors.
Public site loads successfully and the header displays the brand text “Krishna Traders” on all main pages.
Routes for Home (/), Products (/products), About (/about), Contact (/contact), and Admin (/admin) are reachable in the deployed build.
/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml are served and accessible in production.
Contact CTAs (Call, Email, WhatsApp) remain functional after deployment.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: No further UI/UX or content changes beyond go-live deployment and verification.
No new pages, features, or backend schema changes unless required to unblock deployment.
